  "test": "import inspect
import pytest
from langfuse import observe
from langfuse._client.observe import _ContextPreservedSyncGeneratorWrapper, _ContextPreservedAsyncGeneratorWrapper

def test_sync_generator_preserve_context_flag_false(langfuse_memory_client: Any, memory_exporter: Any) -> None:
    @observe(name="no_wrap_sync", capture_output=False, preserve_context=False)
    def gen() -> Generator[int, None, None]:
        yield 1
        yield 2

    g = gen()
    # The returned generator should be the raw generator, not the wrapper
    assert not isinstance(g, _ContextPreservedSyncGeneratorWrapper)
    assert not hasattr(g, "items")
    assert list(g) == [1, 2]
    # Span should still be recorded without output attribute
    langfuse_memory_client.flush()
    spans = [s for s in memory_exporter.get_finished_spans() if s.name == "no_wrap_sync"]
    assert spans
    assert "OBSERVATION_OUTPUT" not in spans[0].attributes

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_async_generator_preserve_context_flag_false(langfuse_memory_client: Any, memory_exporter: Any) -> None:
    @observe(name="no_wrap_async", capture_output=False, preserve_context=False)
    async def agen() -> AsyncGenerator[int, None]:
        for i in range(2):
            yield i

    ag = agen()
    # The returned async generator should be the raw async generator, not the wrapper
    assert not isinstance(ag, _ContextPreservedAsyncGeneratorWrapper)
    assert not hasattr(ag, "items")
    collected = [i async for i in ag]
    assert collected == [0, 1]
    langfuse_memory_client.flush()
    spans = [s for s in memory_exporter.get_finished_spans() if s.name == "no_wrap_async"]
    assert spans
    assert "OBSERVATION_OUTPUT" not in spans[0].attributes"
}
